entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, you're speaking with Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely terrible cycling shoes I bought from you. This is unacceptable! I want my money back immediately.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having a bad experience. I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF90210. And don't give me some runaround. I wore them for one ride and they gave me horrible blisters on my heels. They're completely unusable.
Thank you for that, I'm pulling up your order now. I see the purchase of the Pro-Road cycling shoes. Can I ask, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A fault! They're defective! The material is way too stiff, and I think the alignment for the cleats is off. This is a joke. If I don't get a refund, I'm writing a review on every single website I can find. I'll make sure no one buys these things again.
I completely understand your frustration. Getting blisters is the last thing anyone wants. Please give me just one moment to review our return policy for you.
This is ridiculous. Just give me my money back. I don't have time for this. Get me your manager!

That won't be necessary, sir. I've just confirmed our policy. It looks like you received the item 19 days ago, and we have a 90-day return window for standard items. You are well within that timeframe.
Oh. So you'll take them back then? Just like that?

Yes, of course. I can process this return for a full refund for you right now. I've just initiated it on my end. I'll be sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file. You can just pack up the shoes and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives them, the refund will be credited back to your original payment method.
Wow. Okay. That... was a lot easier than I expected. Thank you.
You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're happy. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thanks for your help, Alex.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
